summary: The comment argues against eliminating or limiting E‑Rate, restricting consultant fee structures, imposing FCC limits on classroom technology use, shortening the comment period, and adding administrative burdens, while supporting continued funding and flexibility for schools and libraries. The commenter opposes any termination or restriction of the E‑Rate program, rejects limits on consultant compensation, and objects to screen‑time limits, while urging the FCC to extend the comment period and ensure new rules are scalable and do not burden applicants.
